summary: Track whether an R19 swapchain has actually submitted Draw work, skip the D3D11 completion fence only for never-submitted fresh/partially initialized swapchains, and preserve the existing bounded fail-closed drain for every rendered swapchain.

C0_RECOVER.evidence: Recovered bookkeeping HEAD eff1a91a5416bd5b7c828395b879316dbee88d92 after CONVERSION-DX9EX-00457 PASS. Structural extraction remains terminal.

C1_REVIEW.evidence: R19 Destroy always created/polled a D3D11 completion query when handle != null, including fresh swapchains that failed during image/RTV initialization before any Draw. OpenXR 1.1.63 requires completion only for submitted graphics commands referring to the swapchain, so the never-submitted path can safely avoid the drain and its 250ms/device-loss failure surface.

C2_IMPLEMENT.evidence: Added per-swapchain gpuWorkSubmitted, set it immediately after Draw in RenderTo, route Projection/Theater through the owner-aware RenderTo signature, bypass the drain only while false, and reset the flag only after destruction ownership resolves.

red_review.missing_contract: Destroy unconditionally required a D3D11 event-query drain for every non-null swapchain handle, even when initialization failed before any Draw command ever referenced a swapchain RTV.

standards: OpenXR 1.1.63 xrDestroySwapchain requires all submitted graphics API commands referring to the swapchain to have completed before destroy; with no submitted commands there is no completion dependency to prove.
